theater: 恰帕斯高地與烏蘇馬辛塔河谷

battle.name: 帕倫克-托尼那戰爭
battle.theater: 恰帕斯高地與烏蘇馬辛塔河谷
battle.brief: 687年起，瑪雅城邦帕倫克與中部高地強國托尼那為邊界、鹽路與水源爭鬥，衝突延續百餘年。762年托尼那大軍攻入帕倫克，焚燒王殿並擄走王室；帕倫克在攝政王母主持下重建，卻再未恢復盛勢。本卡所列的亞述長弓標示的，正是此役的關鍵：投射火力太弱，只能近身速射，勝負要在接近後用刃器分出。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方不是兩支國家軍隊，而是恰帕斯地區幾個互相獨立的瑪雅城邦及其聯盟。第一方是帕倫克：城址位於烏蘇馬辛塔河水系、拉坎哈河東岸的台地之上，本身沒有外牆，靠台地邊緣與層層梯田的陡坡防守；國王屬帕卡爾王統，重大決策由王本人、攝政王母與掌管璽印的祭司集團共同作出，帕倫克從不維持常備軍，平時靠附庸城邦供人，戰時則以王室儀仗、宮廷衛士與盟軍的投矛手大隊拼成遠征部隊。第二方是托尼那：城址在中部恰帕斯高地的山脊上，君主自稱「日面美洲豹」之王，是高地的霸權，領地由奧科辛戈一帶向低地延伸，兵源來自受其控制的村社與進貢城邦，能在雨季前組織數百至數千人的隊伍。與托尼那同一陣線的還有中低地與南部山區的「霍爾」政體，其徽記在帕倫克與邦安帕克的碑銘上被刻成一張弓。第三方是亞克奇蘭、佩德拉斯內格拉斯、邦安帕克等鄰國，它們在不同的年份被捲進同樣的星戰，彼此之間也照樣開火。帕倫克與托尼那之間沒有可以一紙議和的宗主關係，談判與報復交替出現，這正是這場衝突拖過百多年而沒有結論的原因。
countriesEn: The belligerents here were not two national armies but several mutually independent Maya city-states of Chiapas together with their alliances. The first party was Palenque: the city stood on a terrace above the Lacanja, a tributary in the Usumacinta river system, had no curtain wall of its own, and relied on the terrace edge and the steep terraced slopes for defence. Its king belonged to the Pakal dynasty, and major decisions were taken by the ruler, the queen mother and the priestly office that held the seals. Palenque never kept a standing army; in peacetime it drew men from dependent towns, and in wartime it assembled a campaign force out of the royal entourage, palace guards and the dart-thrower corps of its allies. The second party was Tonina: the city sat on a ridge in the central Chiapas highlands, its ruler bore the title of the Sun-faced Jaguar, and it was the hegemon of the highlands, its territory running from the Ocosingo area down into the lowlands, drawing its men from villages and tribute-paying towns under its control and able to muster from several hundred to several thousand men before the rains. On the same side as Tonina stood the polity of the Hol in the central and southern highlands, whose emblem was carved on the stelae of Palenque and Bonampak as a bow. The third parties were the neighbours Yaxchilan, Piedras Negras and Bonampak, dragged into the same star wars in different years and fighting one another in turn. There was no suzerain relationship between Palenque and Tonina that a single treaty could settle; negotiation alternated with revenge, which is precisely why the conflict dragged on for more than a century without a conclusion.
people: 帕倫克一側最關鍵的名字，圍繞著王權在三代之間的交接。帕卡爾一世在位到683年，晚年由其子阿卡爾莫納布三世接位；後者在730年代早逝，王位落在幼子帕卡爾二世手上，母親薩克庫克以攝政王母的身份主持朝政，宮中祭司與掌璽官也握有實權。762年城破時坐鎮帕倫克的正是這位攝政王母與她的兒子，王室成員被托尼那方面擄走，此後帕倫克的碑刻反覆出現「弓矢」與「星戰」字樣，帶著強烈的復仇意味。托尼那方面留下姓名的君主不多，其中最常被引用的是亞什庫克莫：他在帕倫克「十字神廟」的碑銘幻象中作為對頭出現，而他的卒年808年又見於同一批銘文，說明其統治橫跨這場戰爭的中段，雙方世系由此可以對接。亞克奇蘭的鳥虎四世是區域內最有名的將領之一，他的王宮神廟在812年記錄了對帕倫克方面的星戰宣告；邦安帕克神廟的壁畫則留下790年那位帶「霍爾」徽記的舞者。學者方面，布麗姬·柏林把帕倫克碑銘中的「弓矢」事件與托尼那的戰爭聯繫起來，馬克·范齊克與大衛·史圖特等人則從戰俘與獻祭的角度解讀「星戰」，這些解讀直接決定了人們如何估計這場戰爭的規模。
peopleEn: On the Palenque side the decisive names concern the handing of royal power across three generations. Pakal I ruled until 683 and was succeeded by his son Ahkal Mo' Nahb III; the latter died early in the 730s and the throne passed to his young son K'inich Janaab Pakal II, whose mother, the queen mother Sak K'uk', governed as regent, with the palace priesthood and the seal-bearer holding real authority beside them. When the city fell in 762 it was that queen mother and her son who held Palenque, and members of the royal house were carried off by Tonina's side; the stelae that follow keep repeating the signs of the bow and the star war, and they carry an unmistakable note of vengeance. Few of Tonina's rulers are named, but the one most often cited is Yax K'uk' Mo': he appears as an adversary in the serpent vision of the Palenque Temple of the Cross tablets, and his death in 808 is recorded in the same body of inscriptions, which shows that his rule spanned the middle of this war and lets the two dynastic lines be matched. Bird Jaguar IV of Yaxchilan was among the best known commanders of the region; his palace temple records a star war declared against Palenque's side in 812, and the murals of the Bonampak temple preserve the dancer of 790 wearing the emblem of the Hol. On the scholarly side, Brigid Berlin tied the bow event in the Palenque inscriptions to the war with Tonina, while Marc van Zyl and David Stuart read the star war as a declaration of capture and sacrifice; those readings largely determine how the scale of this war is estimated.
kits: 本卡列的是亞述長弓，它並不是帕倫克或托尼那任何一方配發的武器；把它放進這場戰爭，是因為它正好標示了這類中美洲城邦戰爭的真正瓶頸：投射火力太弱，只能在短距離內提供掩護，勝負要在接近之後用刃器解決。亞述體系裡的弓屬複合弓系統，弓臂以木為芯、受力處以角片加固、弦用筋腱，靠一兵一車、邊進邊射的密集弓兵隊在野戰中撕開缺口，車兵與步兵再踏著箭幕推進，這是兩河流域城市國家對付游牧騎兵與山城守軍的標準辦法。帕倫克方面的投射武器主力是投矛器，標槍多配燧石或黑曜石鏃，精英組成的投矛手大隊在開戰時齊射，射程與精度都高過弓；弓也用，帕倫克出土的弓殘件長約一點六至一點八米，箭鏃多為燧石與黑曜石，但拉力與射程明顯遜於亞述弓，只適合近距離速射，這也解釋了「弓矢」為何能同時是一件武器與一枚被刻上石碑的敵方徽記。帕倫克沒有城牆，也沒有投石機與撞車，攻城手段是攀梯、破牆、縱火與挖地道，奪門之後便是黑曜石刃短兵與木棒。交通方面全無車、無馬、無駕馭獸，貴族靠人抬的轎出行，小隊靠獨木舟沿拉坎哈河轉進，一支遠征隊的補給全靠人力背運，這一點比任何弓弩都更能說明瑪雅戰爭的真實限制。
kitsEn: The bow on this card is the Assyrian bow, and it was never issued to either Palenque or Tonina; it is set in this war because it marks the true bottleneck of warfare among the central American city-states: the missile arm was too weak to reach far, so it could only give cover at short range, and the outcome had to be settled after closing, with edged weapons. In the Assyrian system the bow was a composite, with a wooden core stiffened at the stressed sections by horn and strung with sinew; the massed screen of archers, one man to a chariot, shooting while on the move, tore open gaps in the open field, and the chariot troops and infantry then advanced behind the curtain of arrows. That was the standard answer of the Mesopotamian city-states to nomadic cavalry and to mountain defenders. The main missile arm on the Palenque side was the atlatl, its darts usually carrying flint or obsidian points, and the elite corps of throwers opened the fighting with massed volleys whose range and accuracy both exceeded the bow's. Bows were used too: bow fragments excavated at Palenque measure roughly 1.6 to 1.8 metres and their arrowheads are commonly flint or obsidian, but the draw and the range are clearly inferior to an Assyrian bow and serve only for rapid shooting at close quarters, which is also why the bow could be at once a weapon and an enemy emblem carved on stone. Palenque had no curtain wall, no trebuchet and no battering ram; its siege methods were ladders, breaching, fire and tunnelling, and once the gate was taken it came down to obsidian-edged short swords and clubs. In movement there was no cart, no horse and no beast of draught: nobles travelled in litters carried by porters, small parties moved up the Lacanja in dugout canoes, and the supply of a column was carried entirely on human backs. That constraint says more about the real limits of Maya war than any bow or crossbow.
tactics: 瑪雅城邦之間的戰爭有自己一套成熟的儀式與手段。開戰前要行「星戰」宣告：把燃燒的火把與綁上箭的標誌拋下，宣示對方已落入被俘之列，之後才能正式出兵，這類宣告在帕倫克與亞克奇蘭的碑刻上都留下專門的字形與銘文。作戰多選在雨季與旱季之交以及收穫前後，恰好卡在糧食由田入倉的關口，目標是燒田、斷糧與封水，逼對手在缺糧的季節屈服。進攻方慣於利用地形設伏於峽口、渡口與樹林邊緣，待敵縱隊拉開再以投矛齊射與短兵衝擊，取勝的標準不是全殲，而是擄走對方王室與祭司；被擄者通常被帶回本國、當眾羞辱並獻祭，這正是「星戰」字形的實質。防守方則退守台地、廢棄外圍村社、拆掉橋樑，把糧食集中到高處；帕倫克因為位於河流分水處的台地，可以利用坡度與接近通道的有限，遲滯進攻者，也迫使對方無法從遠處施加任何手段來加速戰局。決戰通常發生在城內街巷與神廟台階上：弓手退到台基上居高臨下射擊，投矛手在後列接續齊射，黑曜石刃的短兵在狹窄處展開，勝負在幾十步之內定出。托尼那自高地俯衝下來時靠的是密林小徑與連續突襲，沒有亞述式的車兵縱陣，卻有更短的接觸距離與更陡的仰攻劣勢，這正是它佔優而帕倫克佔劣的根源。
tacticsEn: Wars between Maya city-states followed a settled body of ritual and method. A star war had to be proclaimed before hostilities: burning torches and arrow-bound markers were thrown down to declare that the enemy had already been placed among the captured, and only then could the army march. Such proclamations have their own signs and their own texts in the stelae of Palenque and Yaxchilan. Fighting was timed to the turn of the rains and the dry season and to the harvest, exactly at the point when food moved from field into storehouse; the object was to burn the fields, cut the supply and seal the water, so that the enemy gave way in a hungry season. Attackers habitually took position in ambush at gorges, fords and forest edges, waited for the enemy column to stretch out, and then hit with a volley of darts and a rush of close combat. The standard of victory was not the annihilation of the enemy but the taking of the opposing king and priesthood, who were usually carried home, publicly humiliated and sacrificed, and that is the substance behind the sign of the star war. Defenders withdrew to terraces, abandoned outlying villages and broke the bridges, concentrating food at height. Palenque, standing on a terrace above the watershed of the Lacanja, could use the slope and the narrowness of the approaches to slow the attacker, and it denied the enemy any means of hurling anything at the city from a distance. The decisive engagement usually took place among the streets and the steps of the temple platforms inside the city: archers withdrew to the high ground of the platform and shot down, the dart throwers followed with massed volleys, and edged short weapons fought it out in the narrow space, with the result settled within a few dozen paces. When Tonina came down from the highlands it relied on narrow forest paths and repeated surprise attacks; there was no Assyrian-style line of chariots, but the distance of contact was shorter and the ascent far steeper, and that is the root of Tonina's advantage and of Palenque's disadvantage.
data: 可用的數字大致如下。帕倫克的王宮區集中在台地南端，核心建築群約佔數千平方米，連同周邊農業聚落，聚落人口一般推算在一萬至兩萬之間；托尼那的遺址範圍同樣在數平方公里量級，中部廣場與主體台地在三千平方米上下。兩城的真正差距在人口與腹地，而不在城牆——帕倫克本來就沒有城牆。兩城相距約一百四十公里，陸路要經圖姆巴拉山口再沿格里加爾瓦河谷南下，順路約一百二十至一百四十公里，山路只容單人通行，運糧只能靠肩扛背運。帕倫克有紀年的碑刻集中在615年至783年之間，現存銘文約百餘條，762、783、790、812這幾個年份是全篇最常被引用的戰事節點。亞述弓的常見有效射程約一百五十至二百米，車上弓兵在推進中仍能維持每分鐘數十發的射速；瑪雅投矛器標槍的有效射程多在三十至五十米，考古出土的瑪雅弓殘件長約一點六至一點八米，據此推算有效射程約五十米上下，兩相比較即可看出差距。遠征兵力沒有可靠記載，只能說當時城邦湊得出的隊伍在數百至數千人這個量級，許多殘存銘文只記首領名字而不記人數。凡涉及兵員、射程與距離的精確數字，多為後世的考古推估，引用時仍應與碑刻互證。
dataEn: The figures available are roughly these. The palace zone of Palenque is concentrated at the south end of the terrace, the core of buildings covering several thousand square metres, and with the surrounding farming settlements the population is generally put at between ten and twenty thousand. The site of Tonina covers a comparable area on the order of several square kilometres, with the central plaza and the main platform around three thousand square metres. The real difference between the two cities lay in population and hinterland, not in walls, for Palenque never had a wall at all. The two centres lie about 140 kilometres apart, the land route running through the Tumbala pass and then down the Grijalva valley, some 120 to 140 kilometres by trail, the paths wide enough for a loaded man and no more, so grain could only be carried on shoulders. The dated stelae of Palenque run from 615 to 783, roughly a hundred texts survive, and 762, 783, 790 and 812 are the years most often cited for the fighting. The Assyrian bow's usual effective range is put at 150 to 200 metres, with chariot archers still managing several dozen shots a minute while on the move. Maya atlatl darts were effective to roughly 30 to 50 metres, and the bow fragments recovered archaeologically measure some 1.6 to 1.8 metres, from which an effective range of about 50 metres is inferred; the comparison shows the gap at once. There is no reliable record of the size of a campaign force: all that can be said is that a city-state of the period could assemble a body of men somewhere between several hundred and several thousand, and that many surviving texts name the leader without naming the numbers. Every precise figure for troops, ranges and distances is a later archaeological estimate, and still has to be checked against the inscriptions before it is used.
cause: 打起上來的原因是多層的。最深一層是地理與資源：帕倫克掌握低地的可可、棉花與肥沃的淹水農田，卻要從高地換取鹽、銅、翡翠與黑曜石；托尼那佔著高地的通道與礦脈，卻苦於自己高地出產不足，必須把勢力伸進低地才能拿到作物與人口，兩者的地盤天生咬在一起。第二層是王權的正當性：帕倫克的王統把自己寫成遠方權勢（提卡爾一系，以及「地龍」與「世界樹」的宇宙秩序）的合法繼承者，一旦鄰國用一次成功的襲擊奪走王位或象徵物，整套論述就會崩潰；「星戰」宣告正是這種焦慮的儀式化，宣告本身不等於開戰，卻先把對手的名譽毀掉。第三層是直接導火線：687年前後帕倫克方面記下一次以「弓」為記號的戰事事件，隨後雙方在邊境互相燒村、擄人，越界的報復愈積愈多，最終在762年釀成托尼那大軍直取帕倫克的大攻擊。戰俘與血祭的循環又回饋到下一輪：每一次報復都在碑刻上被刻成神話，把城邦之間的內鬥推成宇宙秩序的戰爭，這也讓停火變得格外困難。
causeEn: There were several layers of reason. The deepest was geography and resources: Palenque held the cacao, the cotton and the rich flood-plain fields of the lowlands, yet had to exchange them for salt, copper, jade and obsidian from the highlands. Tonina held the passes and the ore of the highlands, yet suffered from the poverty of its own terrain and had to push its authority into the lowlands to reach crops and people. The two territories bit into one another by nature. The second layer was the legitimacy of kingship: the Palenque dynasty wrote itself as the lawful heir to distant powers, to the Tikal line and to the earth dragon and the world tree, and once a neighbouring state took the throne or a regalia in a single successful raid the whole argument collapsed. The star war proclamation is that anxiety turned into ritual: the proclamation is not the same thing as the outbreak of war, though it destroys the opponent's reputation in advance. The third layer was the immediate spark. Around 687 the Palenque side recorded a martial event bearing the sign of the bow, and after that the two burned villages and took captives across the border in a spiral of mutual reprisal, until it culminated in the great attack of 762, when a Tonina host struck deep into Palenque. The cycle of captives and blood sacrifice fed the next round in turn: every reprisal was carved on stone as myth, pushing a civil war between city-states into a war of cosmic order, and that too made any truce unusually hard to hold.
impact: 直接後果是帕倫克的衰落。762年城破，王室被擄，核心區建築受損，雖然在攝政王母與後繼者主持下重建，帕倫克再也沒有恢復古典期的規模與外交份量：碑銘中的聯姻與朝貢網絡中斷，城內的匠人、畫師與抄寫匠流失，農業人口外移，聖地周邊的偶像被砸毀或被搬走。此後它的角色更像一件遺跡：亞克奇蘭把它列入星戰對象，邦安帕克的壁畫裡出現帶「霍爾」徽記的舞者，說明低地各城邦在那個世紀末都已捲入同一場崩解。往長遠看，這場戰爭把恰帕斯的權力重心推向更內陸的高地，孕育出後來以邦帕克為中心的高地聯盟，最終在十二世紀成為尤卡坦南緣的主要力量；反過來，低地王國的衰亡也讓外來的小麥玉米農業與新的信仰在廢墟上長出來。到了九世紀末十世紀初，帕倫克的居民基本撤空，建築被林地吞沒，圖畫與碑刻被土壤覆蓋，直到近代才重新被找到，這是一段典型的「戰爭之後是森林」的案例。另有學者把814年前後《萊德斯多夫手抄本》裡那個乘筏自東方來到加勒比海沿岸的鬍鬚男子同這條戰亂路線對照，提醒人們低地並非與外界隔絕，只是連接的方式多經海路而非陸路。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was the decline of Palenque. The city fell in 762, the royal house was carried off and the buildings of the core were damaged. Although it was rebuilt under the regency of the queen mother and her successors, Palenque never regained the scale or the diplomatic weight of the Classic period: the network of marriage and tribute relations recorded in the stelae was broken, the artisans, painters and scribes of the town dispersed, farming population moved away, and the idols around the sanctuary were smashed or carried off. Its role afterwards was closer to that of a monument. Yaxchilan listed it among the targets of a star war, and the murals of Bonampak show the dancer of 790 wearing the emblem of the Hol, all of which shows that the lowland city-states of that late century were being drawn into the same collapse. In the longer run the war pushed the centre of power in Chiapas further inland and produced the highland league that later made Bonampak the pivot of the region and, by the twelfth century, the main force on the southern margins of Yucatan. In reverse, the decay of the lowland kingdoms allowed incoming wheat-and-maize farming and new beliefs to take root among the ruins. By the late ninth and early tenth century the inhabitants of Palenque had largely left, the temples and the palace were covered by forest, and the paintings and stelae were sealed under soil until they were found again in modern times, a textbook case of war followed by forest. Some scholars set the bearded man who arrives on a raft from the east in the Leidesdorff Codex of about 814 against this same line of disruption, as a reminder that the lowlands were not sealed off from the world, only that the connection ran more by sea than by land.
result: 打完之後，帕倫克沒有奪回被擄的王室，也沒有報回762年的仇；它在攝政王母與兩任後嗣手上維持了二十餘年的舊制度，碑刻上仍不斷刻下「弓矢」與「星戰」字樣，卻再沒有恢復對周邊的軍事主動。托尼那贏了最漂亮的一仗：帕倫克被焚、國王被擄，高地的威名因此壓過低地，該城的王號「日面美洲豹」在往後數十年被刻在石碑頂端，被人望見就意味著必須服從。但勝利沒有帶來長久的秩序。帕倫克殘存的文字顯示，八世紀末到九世紀，拉坎哈河谷的城邦聯盟輪番反攻，亞克奇蘭也在812年把帕倫克列入星戰的對象名單；每一次報復都讓另一座城邦成為下一個被報復的對象，聯盟與聯盟之間也開始互相攻擊，戰爭不再有明確的敵我。最終的結局不是某一方取勝，而是雙方都空掉：帕倫克的居民在九世紀末十世紀初遷走，神廟與王宮被林地覆蓋；托尼那在九世紀末也受到伊察人的攻擊而衰落，其中心地位先後讓位於其他高地城邦，十二世紀時已淪為聚落。這場延續百餘年的城邦戰爭，留下的是一座被森林吞掉的古城、一批刻著戰爭與俘獲的碑文，以及一個關於「投射武器不足的城市如何打仗」的完整樣本。
resultEn: When the fighting was over, Palenque had neither recovered its captured royal house nor avenged 762. Under the queen mother and two successors it kept the old order alive for a little over twenty years, still carving the signs of the bow and the star war on its stones, yet it never regained the military initiative over its neighbours. Tonina won the most splendid of its victories: Palenque burned, its king carried off, and the renown of the highlands weighed heavier than the lowlands, its royal title of Sun-faced Jaguar carved at the top of stelae thereafter, so that to see the sign was to be told to obey. But the victory brought no lasting order. The surviving texts of Palenque show that from the late eighth to the ninth century the city-states of the Lacanja valley took turns counter-attacking, and Yaxchilan in 812 included Palenque among the targets of its star war; every reprisal made another city-state the next object of reprisal, and the alliances began to attack one another as well, so that the war no longer had a clear enemy or friend. What ended it was not a victory but the emptying of both sides. The inhabitants of Palenque left in the late ninth and early tenth century, and the temples and the palace were taken over by the forest; Tonina was struck by the Itza in the late ninth century and declined in turn, its central place passing to other highland cities, and by the twelfth century it was no more than a settlement. This city-state war, running for more than a century, left behind a city swallowed by the forest, a body of stelae carved with war and capture, and a complete sample of how a city with too little missile power fights.
